newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain quiet in afternoon - Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain quiet in afternoon - Feb 10.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained very quiet this afternoon with only a few nearby trades reported, market sources said.

"Mondays are usually slow. There was little buying interest today. Higher seller prices, a firm dollar, a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening, Carnival in the Catholic part of Europe and Wednesday's USDA supply/demand figures all kept a lid on activity," one broker said.
Arrived Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $287 a tonne fob Rotterdam, afloat at $283.50 cif and Jan at $284 a tonne cif Rotterdam, up $2 from Friday.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
